figurative_meaning_en: One who assumes various or infinite forms
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুর্গা দেবী অনন্তরূপিণী হিসেবে পূজিত হন।
তাঁর অনন্তরূপিণী স্বরূপে ভক্তরা মুগ্ধ হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Goddess Durga is worshipped as Anantarupini.
Her infinite forms captivate the devotees.
history: This term originates from Hindu mythology, particularly describing Goddess Durga's ability to manifest in countless forms during battles against evil, as depicted in texts like the Devi Mahatmya.
note: Primarily used in religious and poetic contexts to denote divine versatility.
